race.description: Gen Z Northam Cup Packages Available Now Mdn
race.comment: FARADIO (1) is getting back to the sort of form that he showed as a 3YO last season after finishing third by a neck here 10 days ago over 1300m. He will relish the step up to a mile and can get the job done this time. RORY'S REVENGE (3) made up a huge slice of ground to finish fourth here nearly 3 weeks ago at long odds. William Pike steps into the irons, and he will be hard to beat, but the big odds will not be there this time. RUTHLESS BLOOM (9) finished just as quickly as the second pick when finishing just ahead of that runner in third place in the same race. She could settle a touch closer to the pace here and is another each-way hope in an even contest. SHE'S SOME CRAIC (8) battled on well enough when finishing fourth here last start, and she has been crying out for this trip for some time. Stick with her for all top 4 combos. WREXHAM (2) motored home late to finish third at Belmont 2 weeks ago and will try a 1600m for the first time here. Keep him safe.
